newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares mark time ahead of elections.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares mark time ahead of elections.

text.p: Slovenian shares fell slightly on Monday and traders said they expect shares to show little movement ahead of the general elections due November 10.
"The market was calm today as most traders are sidelined by the elections. This could continue until the end of the week," Zmavc Franci, a trader at brokerage Intara said.
The SBI index fell 0.17 perrcent or 2.01 points to 1,190.1.
Turnover more than halved to 107.7 million tolars from 231.4 million.
Traders said daily turnover this week would most likely remain at very low levels as investors mull the outcome of the elections.
Overall nine shares fell, three rose and one was unchanged, while 11 were untraded.
Drugs producer Lek's A issue was the most actively traded, falling 0.10 percent to 20,500 tolars on volume of 3,016 shares for total turnover of 62.1 million tolars.
Bank UBK was the leading decliner, falling 9.03 percent to 6,550 tolars on volume of 65 shares for total turnover of 426,500 tolars.

Trading company Kovinotehna was the biggest gainer, firming 4.65 percent to 450 tolars on volume of 5,460 shares for total turnover of 2.4 million tolars. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
